new_result.statement: For v_i in R^2 with S=sum v_i v_i^T positive definite and nonzero eta orthogonal to both transverse coefficient columns, there is an original-coordinate partition L,T with (sum_L eta_i^2) det(sum_T v_i v_i^T) >= ||eta||^2 det(S)/24.

candidate_refuted.statement: Both nonzero orthogonal leakages in quantitatively transverse B19 banks do not force a universal rank-three cross-singular-value certificate.

partner_result_applied.application: Exact rank-three rotated family A_eps has one-zero principal triple determinant -1/32, giving ||p||_infinity <=3*2^(7/3)=15.119052598738476 uniformly in eps.

next_step: Use the disjoint leakage/transverse packets in a product-space rearrangement inequality that absorbs unwanted coefficient components on both packets before reciprocal local coefficients are paid.
